title: digitaria microbachne subsp. presliana
intro: Digitaria microbachne subsp. presliana, commonly known as Finger Grass, is a type of grass native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, inflammation, and infections, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Finger Grass include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Digitaria microbachne subsp. presliana for medicinal use.
